context: Two teens walk home after class
purpose: Teach: いくらか/わがまま/たびたび/めざす/ほめ/動揺/ぞう/当たら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日のテスト、たびたびケアレスミス、減らないよ。
lines.en: Today's test—I keep making careless mistakes and I can't seem to stop.
lines.style: Frustrated exhale. Sharp attack on the complaint. Quick pace, clipped edges. Frustration sits right at the surface but controlled—not a meltdown, just fed up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、気を抜くと当たらない問題ばっかになるよな。
lines.en: Yeah, one wrong move and suddenly all the questions go sideways.
lines.style: Casual, understanding nod in the voice. Soft steady pace. Comfortable silence between the words—he's not trying to fix anything, just meeting her where she is.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 親に成績、たまにわがまま言うけど、本気でめざす高校あるんだよ。
lines.en: I know I'm sometimes kind of demanding with my parents about grades, but there's this one high school I actually want to get into.
lines.style: Quiet shift toward sincerity. Hesitant opening—checking herself for sounding spoiled. Steadies into honesty by midway through. Slight lean forward in the voice at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 動揺せず勉強続ければ、合格率いくらか上がるはず。
lines.en: If you keep at it without letting it rattle you, your chances have to go up some.
lines.style: Measured, grounded reassurance. Light certainty—not false confidence but genuine belief. Spoken from the side, like he's thinking it through with her, not at her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生にほめられた最後の作文、自信になった。
lines.en: When the teacher praised that essay, it actually gave me something to hold onto.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender. Quiet wonder at the warmth of the memory. Slower pace. Trailing warmth at the end—not weakness, but letting herself feel the good thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ぞうさんのぬいぐるみみたいに、心の支え必要だよな。
lines.en: You need something to hold onto like that—like a comfort thing you actually believe in.
lines.style: Gentle teasing with real kindness underneath. Light, almost playful rhythm. He's making her laugh but also actually saying something true. Warm close.
